capabilities: Render Schematex diagrams from fenced code blocks
Export diagrams as SVG or PNG images
Configure toolbar visibility, sizing, theme, and scroll behavior
extras: Diagram syntax itself is documented externally in the Schematex documentation, not in the README. Obsidian flags the plugin for clipboard access; the README explains it only writes to the clipboard when copying error source.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render Schematex diagram types such as genograms, circuits, ladders, and fishbone diagrams inside notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin supports all Schematex diagram types.

summary: Diagram renderer that displays Schematex diagrams from fenced code blocks with pan, zoom, fullscreen view, and SVG/PNG export.
